# TaskCancelScope

`schemas/api/scope/task-cancel.json`

The scope of task.cancel (backlog #226 entry 23): the task to cancel and why. The operator cancels any task still in Ready; a supervisor only a Ready task it created with no approval in force; an admitted task keeps the hold and revoke path. A cancelled task leaves the Ready bound and is never admitted; cancelling it again changes nothing.

|---|---|---|---|

## Definitions

### CancelReason
